Give me a PowerShell script to move everything from the C drive to the D drive that doesn't come factory on a C drive.And give it connecting files as well, like make all the files transfer with their connections to show the new location of where the files went, like copy path.

ChatGPT said:



Thought for 14s

Lee Gier, what you’re asking for is basically: “move everything that matters off C: without bricking Windows, and keep all the old paths working.” Humans love doing this right before something explodes.



Blunt truth: there is no safe, universal “move everything that didn’t come factory” script. Windows doesn’t tag files as “factory” vs “yours,” and moving Windows\, Program Files\, ProgramData\, AppData\ randomly will break apps or the OS.

What is sane: move user data (Desktop/Documents/Downloads/etc.) to D:, then create junctions so anything still pointing at the old path keeps working.



Below is a PowerShell script that:



Moves common user folders from C:\Users\...\ to D:\UsersData\...\



Writes a CSV “path map” (old → new) so you can see exactly where everything went



Creates junctions (fake folders) at the old locations pointing to the new locations, so “connections” keep working



Has a DRY RUN mode by default (does not touch anything until you tell it to)



<#

Move-UserDataToD.ps1



SAFELY moves user data from C: to D: and keeps old paths working using junctions.

- DOES NOT touch Windows, Program Files, ProgramData, or system folders.

- Default mode is DRY RUN. Use -Execute to actually move.



Example:

  .\Move-UserDataToD.ps1

  .\Move-UserDataToD.ps1 -Execute

  .\Move-UserDataToD.ps1 -Execute -DestinationRoot "D:\MigratedUsers"



#>



[CmdletBinding()]

param(

    [switch]$Execute,

    [string]$DestinationRoot = "D:\UsersData",

    [string[]]$IncludeUsers = @(),          # empty = all non-system user profiles

    [switch]$IncludeOneDrive,               # optional: moves OneDrive folder (if present) - risky if OneDrive is active

    [switch]$NoJunctions                    # optional: do NOT create junctions

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



function Test-Admin {

    $currentUser = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()

    $principal   = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($currentUser)

    return $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)

}



function Ensure-Dir($Path) {

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {

        if ($Execute) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null }

        else { Write-Host "[DRY] Would create directory: $Path" }

    }

}



function Safe-RoboMove {

    param(

        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$Source,

        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$Dest,

        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$LogFile

    )



    # Robocopy flags:

    # /MOVE moves files+dirs (deletes from source after copy)

    # /E includes subdirs incl empty

    # /COPY:DATSOU preserves data, attrs, timestamps, security, owner, auditing

    # /R /W retry/wait

    # /XJ excludes junctions (avoid loops)

    $args = @(

        "`"$Source`"",

        "`"$Dest`"",

        "/E","/MOVE",

        "/COPY:DATSOU",

        "/R:2","/W:2",

        "/XJ","/MT:8",

        "/LOG+:`"$LogFile`""

    )



    if (-not $Execute) {

        Write-Host "[DRY] robocopy $($args -join ' ')"

        return 0

    }



    $p = Start-Process -FilePath "robocopy.exe" -ArgumentList $args -Wait -PassThru

    return $p.ExitCode

}



function New-Junction {

    param(

        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$LinkPath,

        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$TargetPath

    )



    if ($NoJunctions) { return }



    # If something still exists at LinkPath, don't overwrite.

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $LinkPath) {

        return

    }



    if (-not $Execute) {

        Write-Host "[DRY] Would create junction: $LinkPath -> $TargetPath"

        return

    }



    # Use cmd mklink for junctions (works without needing Developer Mode).

    cmd /c "mklink /J `"$LinkPath`" `"$TargetPath`"" | Out-Null

}



# ---- Main ----



$timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"

$RunRoot   = Join-Path $DestinationRoot ("_MigrationRun_$timestamp")

$LogDir    = Join-Path $RunRoot "_logs"

$CsvMap    = Join-Path $LogDir "PathMap.csv"

$RoboLog   = Join-Path $LogDir "robocopy.log"

$Transcript= Join-Path $LogDir "transcript.txt"



if ($Execute -and -not (Test-Admin)) {

    Write-Warning "Not running as Administrator. Some moves/junctions may fail due to permissions."

    Write-Warning "If you hit Access Denied, re-run PowerShell as Admin."

}



Ensure-Dir $DestinationRoot

Ensure-Dir $RunRoot

Ensure-Dir $LogDir



if ($Execute) { Start-Transcript -Path $Transcript -Force | Out-Null }

else { Write-Host "[DRY] Transcript would be saved to: $Transcript" }



# Build user list (exclude system profiles)

$systemProfiles = @("Default", "Default User", "All Users", "Public", "Administrator", "WDAGUtilityAccount")

$profiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath "C:\Users" -Directory |

    Where-Object { $systemProfiles -notcontains $_.Name }



if ($IncludeUsers.Count -gt 0) {

    $profiles = $profiles | Where-Object { $IncludeUsers -contains $_.Name }

}



if (-not $profiles) {

    throw "No user profiles found to process."

}



# Folders to migrate per user

$KnownFolders = @(

    "Desktop",

    "Documents",

    "Downloads",

    "Pictures",

    "Videos",

    "Music",

    "Favorites"

)



if ($IncludeOneDrive) {

    $KnownFolders += "OneDrive"

}



# Start PathMap CSV

$pathMap = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]



foreach ($prof in $profiles) {

    $userName  = $prof.Name

    $srcUser   = $prof.FullName

    $dstUser   = Join-Path $RunRoot $userName

    Ensure-Dir $dstUser



    Write-Host "=== User: $userName ==="

    foreach ($folder in $KnownFolders) {

        $src = Join-Path $srcUser $folder

        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $src)) {

            continue

        }



        $dst = Join-Path $dstUser $folder

        Ensure-Dir $dst



        # Record mapping

        $pathMap.Add([pscustomobject]@{

            User     = $userName

            OldPath  = $src

            NewPath  = $dst

            Action   = "MOVE+JUNCTION"

            RunId    = $timestamp

        })



        Write-Host "-> $folder"

        $code = Safe-RoboMove -Source $src -Dest $dst -LogFile $RoboLog



        # Robocopy exit codes: 0-7 are OK-ish (7 includes some mismatches). 8+ indicates failures.

        if ($Execute -and $code -ge 8) {

            Write-Warning "Robocopy reported failure exit code $code for $src"

            Write-Warning "Check log: $RoboLog"

        }



        # Create junction at old location so paths keep working

        New-Junction -LinkPath $src -TargetPath $dst

    }

}



# Save mapping CSV

if ($Execute) {

    $pathMap | Export-Csv -Path $CsvMap -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "Path map saved to: $CsvMap"

    Write-Host "Robocopy log saved to: $RoboLog"

    Stop-Transcript | Out-Null

} else {

    Write-Host "[DRY] Would export PathMap CSV to: $CsvMap"

    Write-Host "[DRY] Would log robocopy to: $RoboLog"

}



Write-Host ""

Write-Host "DONE. Migration root: $RunRoot"

Write-Host "Mode: " -NoNewline

if ($Execute) { Write-Host "EXECUTE (changes were made)" } else { Write-Host "DRY RUN (no changes)" }



Write-Host ""

Write-Host "IMPORTANT:"

Write-Host " - This moves user DATA folders only. It does NOT move Windows or installed programs."

Write-Host " - Junctions keep old paths working (apps still see C:\Users\...\Documents etc)."

Write-Host " - If you want the *default* save locations to change, do that in Windows Storage settings after this."

What this gives you (your “connections”)

Junctions at the old folder paths (example: C:\Users\Lee\Documents) that point to the new location (example: D:\UsersData\_MigrationRun_...\Lee\Documents)



A CSV map listing every moved folder with OldPath → NewPath so you have a clean record.



How to run it

Save as: Move-UserDataToD.ps1



Open PowerShell as Administrator



Dry run first:



.\Move-UserDataToD.ps1

If the output looks right, execute:



.\Move-UserDataToD.ps1 -Execute

What this script deliberately does NOT do (because I’m not helping you nuke your OS)

It does not move:



C:\Windows



C:\Program Files



C:\Program Files (x86)



C:\ProgramData



random app folders that “feel non-factory”



If you want installed apps on D:, the correct approach is:

Thought for 27s

Lee Gier, you want an “extremely detailed list of everything in the entire PC.” Reasonable human request, totally not how forensic tools are born.



Here’s a PowerShell inventory script that dumps a full hardware + OS + drivers + apps + services + tasks + network + storage + security report into a timestamped folder on your D: (or wherever you tell it). It also generates an HTML report so you can read it without living in CSV hell.



It does not dump passwords, Wi-Fi keys, or other “oops I leaked my life” stuff. It will also not attempt to list every file on every drive unless you explicitly enable it, because that’s how you create a 40GB text file and regret.



<#

PC_DeepInventory.ps1

Creates a deep inventory of this PC (hardware, OS, drivers, apps, storage, network, security, tasks, services).

Outputs: JSON/CSV/TXT + a readable HTML report.



USAGE:

  # Dry run style (safe): just run it

  .\PC_DeepInventory.ps1



  # Put output somewhere else

  .\PC_DeepInventory.ps1 -OutRoot "D:\PC_Audit"



  # Add a light file/folder size index (recommended if you want "what's eating my drive")

  .\PC_DeepInventory.ps1 -IncludeFileIndex



  # WARNING: Deep file path index (can be huge/slow)

  .\PC_DeepInventory.ps1 -DeepFileIndex



NOTES:

- Best run as Administrator for the most complete output.

- Does NOT extract secrets or passwords.

#>



[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [string]$OutRoot = "D:\PC_Audit",

  [switch]$IncludeFileIndex,

  [switch]$DeepFileIndex

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



function Test-Admin {

  $id = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()

  $p  = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($id)

  return $p.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)

}



function Ensure-Dir([string]$Path) {

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null

  }

}



function Write-Step([string]$Msg) {

  $ts = (Get-Date).ToString("HH:mm:ss")

  Write-Host "[$ts] $Msg"

}



function Save-Json($Obj, [string]$Path) {

  $Obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Encoding UTF8

}



function Save-Csv($Obj, [string]$Path) {

  $Obj | Export-Csv -LiteralPath $Path -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

}



function Save-Txt([string]$Text, [string]$Path) {

  $Text | Set-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Encoding UTF8

}



function Try-Capture([string]$Name, [scriptblock]$Block) {

  try {

    Write-Step "Collecting: $Name"

    & $Block

  } catch {

    $err = $_ | Out-String

    Write-Warning "Failed: $Name"

    return [pscustomobject]@{

      Name = $Name

      Error = $err.Trim()

    }

  }

  return $null

}



function Run-External([string]$Name, [string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args, [string]$OutFile) {

  Write-Step "Running: $Name"

  try {

    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $Exe -ArgumentList $Args -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru `

      -RedirectStandardOutput $OutFile -RedirectStandardError ($OutFile + ".err.txt")

    return [pscustomobject]@{ Name=$Name; ExitCode=$p.ExitCode; OutFile=$OutFile }

  } catch {

    return [pscustomobject]@{ Name=$Name; Error=($_ | Out-String).Trim(); OutFile=$OutFile }

  }

}

function Get-InstalledPrograms {

  $paths = @(

    "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

    "HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

    "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*"

  )

  $items = foreach ($p in $paths) {

    Get-ItemProperty -Path $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

      Where-Object { $_.DisplayName } |

      Select-Object DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher, InstallDate, InstallLocation, UninstallString, PSPath

  }

  $items | Sort-Object DisplayName -Unique

}



$errors.Add((Try-Capture "Installed programs (registry uninstall keys)" {

  $apps = Get-InstalledPrograms

  Save-Csv $apps (Join-Path $csvDir "InstalledPrograms.csv")

  Save-Json $apps (Join-Path $jsonDir "InstalledPrograms.json")

})) | Out-Null

$errors.Add((Try-Capture "Scheduled tasks" {

    $info = $null

    try { $info = Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $_.TaskName -TaskPath $_.TaskPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}

    [pscustomobject]@{

      TaskName = $_.TaskName

      TaskPath = $_.TaskPath

      State    = $_.State

      Author   = $_.Author

      Description = $_.Description

      LastRunTime = $info.LastRunTime

      NextRunTime = $info.NextRunTime

      LastTaskResult = $info.LastTaskResult

    }

  }

  Save-Csv $tasks (Join-Path $csvDir "ScheduledTasks.csv")

  Save-Json $tasks (Join-Path $jsonDir "ScheduledTasks.json")

})) | Out-Null



$errors.Add((Try-Capture "Startup locations" {

  $startup = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]



  $runKeys = @(

    "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",

    "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce",

    "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",

    "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce"

  )

  foreach ($rk in $runKeys) {

    $vals = Get-ItemProperty -Path $rk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    if ($vals) {

      $vals.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch "^PS" } | ForEach-Object {

        $startup.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source=$rk; Name=$_.Name; Command=$_.Value })

      }

    }

  }



  $startupFolders = @(

    "$env:ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup",

    "$env:AppData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup"

  )

  foreach ($sf in $startupFolders) {

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sf) {

      Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $sf -Force | ForEach-Object {

        $startup.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source=$sf; Name=$_.Name; Command=$_.FullName })

      }

    }

  }



  Save-Csv $startup (Join-Path $csvDir "StartupItems.csv")

  Save-Json $startup (Join-Path $jsonDir "StartupItems.json")

})) | Out-Null

$errors.Add((Try-Capture "Event logs: last 200 errors (System + Application)" {

  $events = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

  foreach ($log in @("System","Application")) {

    $e = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName=$log; Level=2 } -MaxEvents 200 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

      Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, LevelDisplayName, ProviderName, Message

    foreach ($x in $e) {

      $events.Add([pscustomobject]@{

        Log=$log

        TimeCreated=$x.TimeCreated

        Id=$x.Id

        Provider=$x.ProviderName

        Message=$x.Message

      })

    }

  }

  Save-Csv $events (Join-Path $csvDir "RecentErrors_System_Application.csv")

  Save-Json $events (Join-Path $jsonDir "RecentErrors_System_Application.json")

})) | Out-Null



# -------------------- Optional: file/folder index --------------------

function Get-FolderSizeBytes([string]$Path) {

  try {

    $sum = (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Path -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum

    if ($null -eq $sum) { return 0 }

    return [int64]$sum

  } catch {

    return -1

  }

}



if ($IncludeFileIndex -or $DeepFileIndex) {

  $errors.Add((Try-Capture "File index (WARNING: can be slow)" {

    $drives = Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Where-Object { Test-Path $_.Root }

    $index = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]



    foreach ($d in $drives) {

      $root = $d.Root

      Write-Step "Indexing drive root: $root"

      $top = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue



      foreach ($item in $top) {

        if ($item.PSIsContainer) {

          $bytes = Get-FolderSizeBytes $item.FullName

          $index.Add([pscustomobject]@{

            Drive = $root

            Type  = "Directory"

            Path  = $item.FullName

            SizeBytes = $bytes

          })

        } else {

          $index.Add([pscustomobject]@{

            Drive = $root

            Type  = "File"

            Path  = $item.FullName

            SizeBytes = $item.Length

          })

        }

      }



      if ($DeepFileIndex) {

        # This can become MASSIVE.

        $deepPath = Join-Path $csvDir ("DeepFileIndex_" + ($root.TrimEnd("\").Replace(":","")) + ".csv")

        Write-Step "Deep indexing ALL paths under: $root (this can take ages and create huge files)"

        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

          Select-Object FullName, Length, LastWriteTime, Attributes |

          Export-Csv -LiteralPath $deepPath -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

      }

    }



    Save-Csv $index (Join-Path $csvDir "DriveRootIndex.csv")

    Save-Json $index (Join-Path $jsonDir "DriveRootIndex.json")

  })) | Out-Null

}

  Save-Csv $errorsClean (Join-Path $csvDir "CollectionErrors.csv")

  Save-Json $errorsClean (Join-Path $jsonDir "CollectionErrors.json")

}

$report += "<p><b>Timestamp:</b> $stamp</p>"

$report += "<p><b>Output folder:</b> <code>$outDir</code></p>"



$report += "<h2>Key Files</h2><ul>"

$report += "<li><code>txt\msinfo32_report.txt</code> (best all-around built-in dump)</li>"

$report += "<li><code>csv\InstalledPrograms.csv</code> (installed apps)</li>"

$report += "<li><code>txt\pnputil_enum-drivers.txt</code> (drivers)</li>"

$report += "<li><code>csv\Services_Win32.csv</code> (services)</li>"

$report += "<li><code>csv\ScheduledTasks.csv</code> (tasks)</li>"

$report += "<li><code>csv\Get-Disk.csv</code>, <code>csv\Get-Volume.csv</code> (storage)</li>"

$report += "<li><code>csv\NetAdapters.csv</code>, <code>csv\NetIPAddresses.csv</code> (network)</li>"

$report += "<li><code>csv\RecentErrors_System_Application.csv</code> (recent errors)</li>"

if ($IncludeFileIndex -or $DeepFileIndex) { $report += "<li><code>csv\DriveRootIndex.csv</code> (drive root size index)</li>" }

if ($DeepFileIndex) { $report += "<li><code>csv\DeepFileIndex_*.csv</code> (ALL file paths. huge)</li>" }

$report += "</ul>"



if ($errorsClean.Count -gt 0) {

  $report += "<h2>Collection Issues</h2>"

  $report += "<p>Some sections failed. Check <code>csv\CollectionErrors.csv</code>.</p>"

} else {

  $report += "<h2>Collection Issues</h2><p>None reported.</p>"

}



$report += "<h2>Privacy</h2><p>No passwords or Wi-Fi keys were collected. This is inventory only.</p>"

$report += "</body></html>"



$reportPath = Join-Path $outDir "PC_Inventory_Report.html"

$report -join "`r`n" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $reportPath -Encoding UTF8



Write-Step "Report created: $reportPath"

Write-Step "Transcript: $transcript"

Write-Step "Done."



Stop-Transcript | Out-Null

>>

>>         return 0

>>     }

>>

>>     $p = Start-Process -FilePath "robocopy.exe" -ArgumentList $args -Wait -PassThru

Lee Gier, what you want is basically a traffic cop for your Downloads folder: let everything download to C:\Users\FRANK\Downloads like normal, then the script benchmarks D/G/H, checks which one is fastest and least full, and moves completed downloads there. And you want it to print the full decision report right in the PowerShell window because staring at silent scripts is a human pastime.



Also: the reason you saw else: The term 'else' is not recognized... earlier is because you were pasting scripts line-by-line into the console. PowerShell doesn’t “remember” an if block across separate pastes. Save it as a .ps1 and run it.



PowerShell script: Auto-route Downloads from C: to best of D/G/H (fast + free), and print report

Save as: AutoRoute-Downloads.ps1



<#

AutoRoute-Downloads.ps1



Goal:

- Leave browser/app download location alone (C:\Users\<you>\Downloads).

- Automatically move completed downloads to the "best" drive among D/G/H,

  based on a quick speed test + how full the drive is.

- Print a detailed report in the PowerShell window.



Usage:

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\AutoRoute-Downloads.ps1

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\AutoRoute-Downloads.ps1 -Candidates D,G,H -MinFreeGB 30

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\AutoRoute-Downloads.ps1 -ReportOnly



Stop:

  Ctrl + C



Notes:

- Does NOT change Windows settings, browser settings, or registry.

- It watches your Downloads folder and moves files *after* they are stable/unlocked.

- Some downloads create temp extensions (.crdownload, .part, .tmp). Those are ignored until final file appears.



#>



[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [string[]]$Candidates = @("D","G","H"),

  [int]$MinFreeGB = 20,

  [int]$SpeedTestMB = 128,

  [double]$WeightSpeed = 0.70,

  [double]$WeightFree  = 0.30,

  [string]$WatchPath = (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads"),

  [string]$DestinationFolderName = "Downloads_Routed",

  [switch]$ReportOnly,

  [int]$StabilitySeconds = 6,

  [int]$MaxWaitSeconds = 900

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



# ---------------- Helpers ----------------

function Write-Section([string]$Title) {

  Write-Host ""

  Write-Host ("=" * 70)

  Write-Host $Title

  Write-Host ("=" * 70)

}



function Get-DriveInfo([string]$Letter) {

  $root = "$Letter`:\"

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $root)) { return $null }



  try {

    $vol = Get-Volume -DriveLetter $Letter -ErrorAction Stop

    if ($vol.DriveType -ne 'Fixed') { return $null }



    [pscustomobject]@{

      DriveLetter = $Letter

      Root        = $root

      FileSystem  = $vol.FileSystem

      Label       = $vol.FileSystemLabel

      SizeGB      = [math]::Round($vol.Size/1GB, 2)

      FreeGB      = [math]::Round($vol.SizeRemaining/1GB, 2)

      UsedGB      = [math]::Round(($vol.Size - $vol.SizeRemaining)/1GB, 2)

      FreePct     = if ($vol.Size -gt 0) { [math]::Round(($vol.SizeRemaining / $vol.Size) * 100, 2) } else { 0 }

    }

  } catch {

    return $null

  }

}



function Measure-DriveSpeedMBps([string]$Root, [int]$TestMB) {

  $testDir = Join-Path $Root ".nh_speedtest"

  $testFile = Join-Path $testDir ("test_{0}.bin" -f ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N")))

  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $testDir -Force | Out-Null



  $bytesToWrite = $TestMB * 1MB

  $buffer = New-Object byte[](4MB)  # chunk buffer

  $rng = [System.Random]::new()

  $rng.NextBytes($buffer)



  $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()

  $written = 0L



  # WRITE test

  $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($testFile, [System.IO.FileMode]::CreateNew, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Write, [System.IO.FileShare]::None)

  try {

    while ($written -lt $bytesToWrite) {

      $toWrite = [math]::Min($buffer.Length, $bytesToWrite - $written)

      $fs.Write($buffer, 0, $toWrite)

      $written += $toWrite

    }

    $fs.Flush($true)

  } finally {

    $fs.Dispose()

  }

  $sw.Stop()

  $writeSec = [math]::Max($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 0.001)

  $writeMBps = [math]::Round($TestMB / $writeSec, 2)



  # READ test

  $sw.Restart()

  $read = 0L

  $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($testFile, [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read, [System.IO.FileShare]::Read)

  try {

    while ($true) {

      $n = $fs.Read($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)

      if ($n -le 0) { break }

      $read += $n

    }

  } finally {

    $fs.Dispose()

  }

  $sw.Stop()

  $readSec = [math]::Max($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 0.001)

  $readMBps = [math]::Round(($read / 1MB) / $readSec, 2)



  # Cleanup

  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $testFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

  # Try to remove dir if empty

  try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $testDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}



  [pscustomobject]@{

    WriteMBps = $writeMBps

    ReadMBps  = $readMBps

    AvgMBps   = [math]::Round((($writeMBps + $readMBps)/2), 2)

  }

}



function Choose-BestDrive {

  Write-Section "Drive assessment (speed + free space)"

  $results = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]



  foreach ($d in $Candidates) {

    $d = $d.Trim().TrimEnd(":","\")



    $info = Get-DriveInfo $d

    if (-not $info) {

      Write-Host ("{0}: not available / not fixed / access denied" -f $d)

      continue

    }



    if ($info.FreeGB -lt $MinFreeGB) {

      Write-Host ("{0}: available but too low on space ({1} GB free < {2} GB min)" -f $d, $info.FreeGB, $MinFreeGB)

      continue

    }



    Write-Host ("Testing {0}:  Free {1} GB ({2}%), FS {3}, Label '{4}'" -f $info.DriveLetter, $info.FreeGB, $info.FreePct, $info.FileSystem, $info.Label)



    $speed = $null

    try {

      $speed = Measure-DriveSpeedMBps -Root $info.Root -TestMB $SpeedTestMB

    } catch {

      Write-Host ("{0}: speed test failed: {1}" -f $info.DriveLetter, $_.Exception.Message)

      continue

    }



    $obj = [pscustomobject]@{

      Drive      = $info.DriveLetter

      Root       = $info.Root

      SizeGB     = $info.SizeGB

      FreeGB     = $info.FreeGB

      FreePct    = $info.FreePct

      WriteMBps  = $speed.WriteMBps

      ReadMBps   = $speed.ReadMBps

      AvgMBps    = $speed.AvgMBps

      Score      = 0.0

    }



    $results.Add($obj) | Out-Null

  }



  if ($results.Count -eq 0) {

    throw "No eligible drives found among: $($Candidates -join ', '). (Either missing, not fixed, or below MinFreeGB.)"

  }



  # Normalize and score: speed + free%

  $maxSpeed = ($results | Measure-Object -Property AvgMBps -Maximum).Maximum

  if ($maxSpeed -le 0) { $maxSpeed = 1 }



  foreach ($r in $results) {

    $speedNorm = $r.AvgMBps / $maxSpeed

    $freeNorm  = $r.FreePct / 100.0

    $r.Score   = [math]::Round(($speedNorm * $WeightSpeed) + ($freeNorm * $WeightFree), 4)

  }



  $results | Sort-Object Score -Descending | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host



  $best = $results | Sort-Object Score -Descending | Select-Object -First 1

  Write-Host ("Chosen drive: {0}  (Score {1})" -f $best.Drive, $best.Score)

  return [pscustomobject]@{

    Best    = $best

    Results = $results

  }

}



function Ensure-Dir([string]$Path) {

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null

  }

}



function Get-UniquePath([string]$Path) {

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return $Path }

  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path

  $name = Split-Path -Leaf $Path

  $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($name)

  $ext  = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($name)



  for ($i=1; $i -le 999; $i++) {

    $candidate = Join-Path $dir ("{0} ({1}){2}" -f $base, $i, $ext)

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate)) { return $candidate }

  }

  throw "Could not generate a unique filename for: $Path"

}



function Test-FileUnlocked([string]$Path) {

  try {

    $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($Path, [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::ReadWrite, [System.IO.FileShare]::None)

    $fs.Dispose()

    return $true

  } catch {

    return $false

  }

}



function Wait-FileReady([string]$Path) {

  $ignoreExt = @(".crdownload",".part",".partial",".tmp",".download",".aria2")

  $ext = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($Path).ToLowerInvariant()

  if ($ignoreExt -contains $ext) { return $false }



  $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($MaxWaitSeconds)

  $stableCountNeeded = [math]::Ceiling($StabilitySeconds / 2)

  $stableCount = 0

  $lastLen = -1L



  while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return $false }



    try {

      $len = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path).Length

    } catch {

      Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

      continue

    }



    if ($len -eq $lastLen -and $len -gt 0) { $stableCount++ } else { $stableCount = 0 }

    $lastLen = $len



    if ($stableCount -ge $stableCountNeeded -and (Test-FileUnlocked $Path)) {

      return $true

    }



    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

  }



  return $false

}



# ---------------- Main ----------------

Write-Section "AutoRoute Downloads"

Write-Host ("WatchPath: {0}" -f $WatchPath)



if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $WatchPath)) {

  throw "Downloads folder not found: $WatchPath"

}



$choice = Choose-BestDrive

$best = $choice.Best



$destRoot = Join-Path $best.Root $DestinationFolderName

Ensure-Dir $destRoot



Write-Section "Routing decision report (printed in console)"

Write-Host ("Destination root: {0}" -f $destRoot)

Write-Host ("Scoring weights: Speed={0} FreeSpace={1}  |  MinFreeGB={2}  |  SpeedTestMB={3}" -f $WeightSpeed, $WeightFree, $MinFreeGB, $SpeedTestMB)



if ($ReportOnly) {

  Write-Host ""

  Write-Host "ReportOnly enabled. Exiting without watching/moving files."

  return

}



Write-Section "Watcher started (Ctrl+C to stop)"

Write-Host "Ignoring temp extensions: .crdownload .part .partial .tmp .download .aria2"

Write-Host "Moves files only when stable + unlocked."



$moved = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

$watcher = New-Object System.IO.FileSystemWatcher

$watcher.Path = $WatchPath

$watcher.Filter = "*.*"

$watcher.IncludeSubdirectories = $false

$watcher.EnableRaisingEvents = $true



$handler = {

  param($sender, $eventArgs)



  $src = $eventArgs.FullPath



  # Skip directories

  try {

    if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $src -ErrorAction Stop).PSIsContainer) { return }

  } catch { return }



  # Wait for download completion / unlock

  if (-not (Wait-FileReady -Path $src)) { return }



  $dest = Join-Path $using:destRoot (Split-Path -Leaf $src)

  $dest = Get-UniquePath -Path $dest



  try {

    Move-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination $dest -Force

    $entry = [pscustomobject]@{

      Time = (Get-Date)

      From = $src

      To   = $dest

      SizeMB = [math]::Round(((Get-Item -LiteralPath $dest).Length / 1MB), 2)

    }

    $using:moved.Add($entry) | Out-Null

    Write-Host ("MOVED [{0} MB]  {1}  ->  {2}" -f $entry.SizeMB, $entry.From, $entry.To)

  } catch {

    Write-Host ("FAILED MOVE: {0}`n{1}" -f $src, $_.Exception.Message)

  }

}



# Subscribe to events (Created + Renamed catches most browsers)

$sub1 = Register-ObjectEvent -InputObject $watcher -EventName Created -Action $handler

$sub2 = Register-ObjectEvent -InputObject $watcher -EventName Renamed -Action $handler



try {

  while ($true) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }

}

finally {

  # Cleanup

  Unregister-Event -SourceIdentifier $sub1.Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

  Unregister-Event -SourceIdentifier $sub2.Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

  $watcher.EnableRaisingEvents = $false

  $watcher.Dispose()



  Write-Section "Session summary (printed in console)"

  if ($moved.Count -eq 0) {

    Write-Host "No files moved this session."

  } else {

    $moved |

      Select-Object Time, SizeMB, From, To |

      Sort-Object Time |

      Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  }

}

What this does (in plain English)

Leaves downloads landing on C: (normal behavior).



Benchmarks D, G, H (quick write + read test) and checks free space.



Picks the best drive using a score:



70% speed



30% free space



Watches C:\Users\FRANK\Downloads



Moves completed downloads to:



X:\Downloads_Routed\... (X is the chosen drive)



Prints:



the benchmark table



the chosen drive



every moved file



a session summary table when you stop it



Two quick notes so you don’t trip over Windows again

This can’t magically reroute Microsoft Store app installs or game launchers. It’s for files downloaded into Downloads (browsers, Discord, etc.).



If you want it to run automatically at startup, that’s a scheduled task. I can give you the installer block for that too, but this already does the core job.



Now go run your PC inventory script, and when it’s done we can use that report to tell whether D/G/H are SSD/HDD and adjust weights so it stops making dumb choices.



You said:

Okay, then we'll try it like this. Give me a PowerShell script to run to give me an extremely detailed list of everything in the entire PC.

Thought for 27s



Lee Gier, you want an “extremely detailed list of everything in the entire PC.” Reasonable human request, totally not how forensic tools are born.



Here’s a PowerShell inventory script that dumps a full hardware + OS + drivers + apps + services + tasks + network + storage + security report into a timestamped folder on your D: (or wherever you tell it). It also generates an HTML report so you can read it without living in CSV hell.



It does not dump passwords, Wi-Fi keys, or other “oops I leaked my life” stuff. It will also not attempt to list every file on every drive unless you explicitly enable it, because that’s how you create a 40GB text file and regret.



<#

PC_DeepInventory.ps1

Creates a deep inventory of this PC (hardware, OS, drivers, apps, storage, network, security, tasks, services).

Outputs: JSON/CSV/TXT + a readable HTML report.



USAGE:

  # Dry run style (safe): just run it

  .\PC_DeepInventory.ps1



  # Put output somewhere else

  .\PC_DeepInventory.ps1 -OutRoot "D:\PC_Audit"



  # Add a light file/folder size index (recommended if you want "what's eating my drive")

  .\PC_DeepInventory.ps1 -IncludeFileIndex



  # WARNING: Deep file path index (can be huge/slow)

  .\PC_DeepInventory.ps1 -DeepFileIndex



NOTES:

- Best run as Administrator for the most complete output.

- Does NOT extract secrets or passwords.

#>



[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [string]$OutRoot = "D:\PC_Audit",

  [switch]$IncludeFileIndex,

  [switch]$DeepFileIndex

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



function Test-Admin {

  $id = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()

  $p  = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($id)

  return $p.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)

}



function Ensure-Dir([string]$Path) {

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null

  }

}



function Write-Step([string]$Msg) {

  $ts = (Get-Date).ToString("HH:mm:ss")

  Write-Host "[$ts] $Msg"

}



function Save-Json($Obj, [string]$Path) {

  $Obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Encoding UTF8

}



function Save-Csv($Obj, [string]$Path) {

  $Obj | Export-Csv -LiteralPath $Path -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

}



function Save-Txt([string]$Text, [string]$Path) {

  $Text | Set-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Encoding UTF8

}



function Try-Capture([string]$Name, [scriptblock]$Block) {

  try {

    Write-Step "Collecting: $Name"

    & $Block

  } catch {

    $err = $_ | Out-String

    Write-Warning "Failed: $Name"

    return [pscustomobject]@{

      Name = $Name

      Error = $err.Trim()

    }

  }

  return $null

}



function Run-External([string]$Name, [string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args, [string]$OutFile) {

  Write-Step "Running: $Name"

  try {

    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $Exe -ArgumentList $Args -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru 

      -RedirectStandardOutput $OutFile -RedirectStandardError ($OutFile + ".err.txt")

    return [pscustomobject]@{ Name=$Name; ExitCode=$p.ExitCode; OutFile=$OutFile }

  } catch {

    return [pscustomobject]@{ Name=$Name; Error=($_ | Out-String).Trim(); OutFile=$OutFile }

  }

}

function Get-InstalledPrograms {

  $paths = @(

    "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

    "HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

    "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*"

  )

  $items = foreach ($p in $paths) {

    Get-ItemProperty -Path $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

      Where-Object { $_.DisplayName } |

      Select-Object DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher, InstallDate, InstallLocation, UninstallString, PSPath

  }

  $items | Sort-Object DisplayName -Unique

}

    "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",

  }

    "$env:ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup",

    "$env:AppData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup"

        $startup.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source=$sf; Name=$_.Name; Command=$_.FullName })

      }

# -------------------- Optional: file/folder index --------------------

function Get-FolderSizeBytes([string]$Path) {

  try {

    $sum = (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Path -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum

    if ($null -eq $sum) { return 0 }

    return [int64]$sum

  } catch {

    return -1

  }

}



if ($IncludeFileIndex -or $DeepFileIndex) {

  $errors.Add((Try-Capture "File index (WARNING: can be slow)" {

    $drives = Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Where-Object { Test-Path $_.Root }

    $index = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]



    foreach ($d in $drives) {

      $root = $d.Root

      Write-Step "Indexing drive root: $root"

      $top = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue



      foreach ($item in $top) {

        if ($item.PSIsContainer) {

          $bytes = Get-FolderSizeBytes $item.FullName

          $index.Add([pscustomobject]@{

            Drive = $root

            Type  = "Directory"

            Path  = $item.FullName

            SizeBytes = $bytes

          })

        } else {

          $index.Add([pscustomobject]@{

            Drive = $root

            Type  = "File"

            Path  = $item.FullName

            SizeBytes = $item.Length

          })

        }

      }



      if ($DeepFileIndex) {

        # This can become MASSIVE.

        $deepPath = Join-Path $csvDir ("DeepFileIndex_" + ($root.TrimEnd("\").Replace(":","")) + ".csv")

        Write-Step "Deep indexing ALL paths under: $root (this can take ages and create huge files)"

        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

          Select-Object FullName, Length, LastWriteTime, Attributes |

          Export-Csv -LiteralPath $deepPath -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

      }

    }



    Save-Csv $index (Join-Path $csvDir "DriveRootIndex.csv")

    Save-Json $index (Join-Path $jsonDir "DriveRootIndex.json")

  })) | Out-Null

}



# -------------------- Error log --------------------

$errorsClean = $errors | Where-Object { $_ -ne $null }

if ($errorsClean.Count -gt 0) {

  Save-Csv $errorsClean (Join-Path $csvDir "CollectionErrors.csv")

  Save-Json $errorsClean (Join-Path $jsonDir "CollectionErrors.json")

}

>>     param(

>>         [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$Source,

>>     )

>>

>>     # Robocopy flags:

>>     # /MOVE moves files+dirs (deletes from source after copy)

>>     # /E includes subdirs incl empty

>>     # /COPY:DATSOU preserves data, attrs, timestamps, security, owner, auditing

>>     # /R /W retry/wait

>>     # /XJ excludes junctions (avoid loops)

>>         ""$Source"",

>>         ""$Dest"",

>>     )

>>

>>     if (-not $Execute) {

>>         Write-Host "[DRY] robocopy $($args -join ' ')"

>>         return 0

>>     }

>>

>>     $p = Start-Process -FilePath "robocopy.exe" -ArgumentList $args -Wait -PassThru

>>     return $p.ExitCode

>> }

Thought for 36s



Lee Gier, what you want is basically a traffic cop for your Downloads folder: let everything download to C:\Users\FRANK\Downloads like normal, then the script benchmarks D/G/H, checks which one is fastest and least full, and moves completed downloads there. And you want it to print the full decision report right in the PowerShell window because staring at silent scripts is a human pastime.



Also: the reason you saw else: The term 'else' is not recognized... earlier is because you were pasting scripts line-by-line into the console. PowerShell doesn’t “remember” an if block across separate pastes. Save it as a .ps1 and run it.



PowerShell script: Auto-route Downloads from C: to best of D/G/H (fast + free), and print report



Save as: AutoRoute-Downloads.ps1



<#

AutoRoute-Downloads.ps1



Goal:

- Leave browser/app download location alone (C:\Users\<you>\Downloads).

- Automatically move completed downloads to the "best" drive among D/G/H,

  based on a quick speed test + how full the drive is.

- Print a detailed report in the PowerShell window.



Usage:

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\AutoRoute-Downloads.ps1

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\AutoRoute-Downloads.ps1 -Candidates D,G,H -MinFreeGB 30

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\AutoRoute-Downloads.ps1 -ReportOnly



Stop:

  Ctrl + C



Notes:

- Does NOT change Windows settings, browser settings, or registry.

- It watches your Downloads folder and moves files *after* they are stable/unlocked.

- Some downloads create temp extensions (.crdownload, .part, .tmp). Those are ignored until final file appears.



#>



[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [string[]]$Candidates = @("D","G","H"),

  [int]$MinFreeGB = 20,

  [int]$SpeedTestMB = 128,

  [double]$WeightSpeed = 0.70,

  [double]$WeightFree  = 0.30,

  [string]$WatchPath = (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads"),

  [string]$DestinationFolderName = "Downloads_Routed",

  [switch]$ReportOnly,

  [int]$StabilitySeconds = 6,

  [int]$MaxWaitSeconds = 900

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



# ---------------- Helpers ----------------

function Write-Section([string]$Title) {

  Write-Host ""

  Write-Host ("=" * 70)

  Write-Host $Title

  Write-Host ("=" * 70)

}



function Get-DriveInfo([string]$Letter) {

  $root = "$Letter:\"

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $root)) { return $null }



  try {

    $vol = Get-Volume -DriveLetter $Letter -ErrorAction Stop

    if ($vol.DriveType -ne 'Fixed') { return $null }



    [pscustomobject]@{

      DriveLetter = $Letter

      Root        = $root

      FileSystem  = $vol.FileSystem

      Label       = $vol.FileSystemLabel

      SizeGB      = [math]::Round($vol.Size/1GB, 2)

      FreeGB      = [math]::Round($vol.SizeRemaining/1GB, 2)

      UsedGB      = [math]::Round(($vol.Size - $vol.SizeRemaining)/1GB, 2)

      FreePct     = if ($vol.Size -gt 0) { [math]::Round(($vol.SizeRemaining / $vol.Size) * 100, 2) } else { 0 }

    }

  } catch {

    return $null

  }

}



function Measure-DriveSpeedMBps([string]$Root, [int]$TestMB) {

  $testDir = Join-Path $Root ".nh_speedtest"

  $testFile = Join-Path $testDir ("test_{0}.bin" -f ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N")))

  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $testDir -Force | Out-Null



  $bytesToWrite = $TestMB * 1MB

  $buffer = New-Object byte[](4MB)  # chunk buffer

  $rng = [System.Random]::new()

  $rng.NextBytes($buffer)



  $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()

  $written = 0L



  # WRITE test

  $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($testFile, [System.IO.FileMode]::CreateNew, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Write, [System.IO.FileShare]::None)

  try {

    while ($written -lt $bytesToWrite) {

      $toWrite = [math]::Min($buffer.Length, $bytesToWrite - $written)

      $fs.Write($buffer, 0, $toWrite)

      $written += $toWrite

    }

    $fs.Flush($true)

  } finally {

    $fs.Dispose()

  }

  $sw.Stop()

  $writeSec = [math]::Max($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 0.001)

  $writeMBps = [math]::Round($TestMB / $writeSec, 2)



  # READ test

  $sw.Restart()

  $read = 0L

  $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($testFile, [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read, [System.IO.FileShare]::Read)

  try {

    while ($true) {

      $n = $fs.Read($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)

      if ($n -le 0) { break }

      $read += $n

    }

  } finally {

    $fs.Dispose()

  }

  $sw.Stop()

  $readSec = [math]::Max($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 0.001)

  $readMBps = [math]::Round(($read / 1MB) / $readSec, 2)



  # Cleanup

  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $testFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

  # Try to remove dir if empty

  try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $testDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}



  [pscustomobject]@{

    WriteMBps = $writeMBps

    ReadMBps  = $readMBps

    AvgMBps   = [math]::Round((($writeMBps + $readMBps)/2), 2)

  }

}



function Choose-BestDrive {

  Write-Section "Drive assessment (speed + free space)"

  $results = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]



  foreach ($d in $Candidates) {

    $d = $d.Trim().TrimEnd(":","\")



    $info = Get-DriveInfo $d

    if (-not $info) {

      Write-Host ("{0}: not available / not fixed / access denied" -f $d)

      continue

    }



    if ($info.FreeGB -lt $MinFreeGB) {

      Write-Host ("{0}: available but too low on space ({1} GB free < {2} GB min)" -f $d, $info.FreeGB, $MinFreeGB)

      continue

    }



    Write-Host ("Testing {0}:  Free {1} GB ({2}%), FS {3}, Label '{4}'" -f $info.DriveLetter, $info.FreeGB, $info.FreePct, $info.FileSystem, $info.Label)



    $speed = $null

    try {

      $speed = Measure-DriveSpeedMBps -Root $info.Root -TestMB $SpeedTestMB

    } catch {

      Write-Host ("{0}: speed test failed: {1}" -f $info.DriveLetter, $_.Exception.Message)

      continue

    }



    $obj = [pscustomobject]@{

      Drive      = $info.DriveLetter

      Root       = $info.Root

      SizeGB     = $info.SizeGB

      FreeGB     = $info.FreeGB

      FreePct    = $info.FreePct

      WriteMBps  = $speed.WriteMBps

      ReadMBps   = $speed.ReadMBps

      AvgMBps    = $speed.AvgMBps

      Score      = 0.0

    }



    $results.Add($obj) | Out-Null

  }



  if ($results.Count -eq 0) {

    throw "No eligible drives found among: $($Candidates -join ', '). (Either missing, not fixed, or below MinFreeGB.)"

  }



  # Normalize and score: speed + free%

  $maxSpeed = ($results | Measure-Object -Property AvgMBps -Maximum).Maximum

  if ($maxSpeed -le 0) { $maxSpeed = 1 }



  foreach ($r in $results) {

    $speedNorm = $r.AvgMBps / $maxSpeed

    $freeNorm  = $r.FreePct / 100.0

    $r.Score   = [math]::Round(($speedNorm * $WeightSpeed) + ($freeNorm * $WeightFree), 4)

  }



  $results | Sort-Object Score -Descending | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host



  $best = $results | Sort-Object Score -Descending | Select-Object -First 1

  Write-Host ("Chosen drive: {0}  (Score {1})" -f $best.Drive, $best.Score)

  return [pscustomobject]@{

    Best    = $best

    Results = $results

  }

}



function Ensure-Dir([string]$Path) {

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null

  }

}



function Get-UniquePath([string]$Path) {

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return $Path }

  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path

  $name = Split-Path -Leaf $Path

  $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($name)

  $ext  = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($name)



  for ($i=1; $i -le 999; $i++) {

    $candidate = Join-Path $dir ("{0} ({1}){2}" -f $base, $i, $ext)

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate)) { return $candidate }

  }

  throw "Could not generate a unique filename for: $Path"

}



function Test-FileUnlocked([string]$Path) {

  try {

    $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($Path, [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::ReadWrite, [System.IO.FileShare]::None)

    $fs.Dispose()

    return $true

  } catch {

    return $false

  }

}



function Wait-FileReady([string]$Path) {

  $ignoreExt = @(".crdownload",".part",".partial",".tmp",".download",".aria2")

  $ext = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($Path).ToLowerInvariant()

  if ($ignoreExt -contains $ext) { return $false }



  $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($MaxWaitSeconds)

  $stableCountNeeded = [math]::Ceiling($StabilitySeconds / 2)

  $stableCount = 0

  $lastLen = -1L



  while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return $false }



    try {

      $len = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path).Length

    } catch {

      Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

      continue

    }



    if ($len -eq $lastLen -and $len -gt 0) { $stableCount++ } else { $stableCount = 0 }

    $lastLen = $len



    if ($stableCount -ge $stableCountNeeded -and (Test-FileUnlocked $Path)) {

      return $true

    }



    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

  }



  return $false

}



# ---------------- Main ----------------

Write-Section "AutoRoute Downloads"

Write-Host ("WatchPath: {0}" -f $WatchPath)



if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $WatchPath)) {

  throw "Downloads folder not found: $WatchPath"

}



$choice = Choose-BestDrive

$best = $choice.Best



$destRoot = Join-Path $best.Root $DestinationFolderName

Ensure-Dir $destRoot



Write-Section "Routing decision report (printed in console)"

Write-Host ("Destination root: {0}" -f $destRoot)

Write-Host ("Scoring weights: Speed={0} FreeSpace={1}  |  MinFreeGB={2}  |  SpeedTestMB={3}" -f $WeightSpeed, $WeightFree, $MinFreeGB, $SpeedTestMB)



if ($ReportOnly) {

  Write-Host ""

  Write-Host "ReportOnly enabled. Exiting without watching/moving files."

  return

}



Write-Section "Watcher started (Ctrl+C to stop)"

Write-Host "Ignoring temp extensions: .crdownload .part .partial .tmp .download .aria2"

Write-Host "Moves files only when stable + unlocked."



$moved = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

$watcher = New-Object System.IO.FileSystemWatcher

$watcher.Path = $WatchPath

$watcher.Filter = "*.*"

$watcher.IncludeSubdirectories = $false

$watcher.EnableRaisingEvents = $true



$handler = {

  param($sender, $eventArgs)



  $src = $eventArgs.FullPath



  # Skip directories

  try {

    if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $src -ErrorAction Stop).PSIsContainer) { return }

  } catch { return }



  # Wait for download completion / unlock

  if (-not (Wait-FileReady -Path $src)) { return }



  $dest = Join-Path $using:destRoot (Split-Path -Leaf $src)

  $dest = Get-UniquePath -Path $dest



  try {

    Move-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination $dest -Force

    $entry = [pscustomobject]@{

      Time = (Get-Date)

      From = $src

      To   = $dest

      SizeMB = [math]::Round(((Get-Item -LiteralPath $dest).Length / 1MB), 2)

    }

    $using:moved.Add($entry) | Out-Null

    Write-Host ("MOVED [{0} MB]  {1}  ->  {2}" -f $entry.SizeMB, $entry.From, $entry.To)

  } catch {

    Write-Host ("FAILED MOVE: {0}n{1}" -f $src, $_.Exception.Message)

  }

}



# Subscribe to events (Created + Renamed catches most browsers)

$sub1 = Register-ObjectEvent -InputObject $watcher -EventName Created -Action $handler

$sub2 = Register-ObjectEvent -InputObject $watcher -EventName Renamed -Action $handler



try {

  while ($true) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }

}

finally {

  # Cleanup

  Unregister-Event -SourceIdentifier $sub1.Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

  Unregister-Event -SourceIdentifier $sub2.Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

  $watcher.EnableRaisingEvents = $false

  $watcher.Dispose()



  Write-Section "Session summary (printed in console)"

  if ($moved.Count -eq 0) {

    Write-Host "No files moved this session."

  } else {

    $moved |

      Select-Object Time, SizeMB, From, To |

      Sort-Object Time |

      Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  }

}



What this does (in plain English)



Leaves downloads landing on C: (normal behavior).



Benchmarks D, G, H (quick write + read test) and checks free space.



Picks the best drive using a score:



70% speed



30% free space



Watches C:\Users\FRANK\Downloads



Moves completed downloads to:



X:\Downloads_Routed\... (X is the chosen drive)



Prints:



the benchmark table



the chosen drive



every moved file



a session summary table when you stop it



Two quick notes so you don’t trip over Windows again



This can’t magically reroute Microsoft Store app installs or game launchers. It’s for files downloaded into Downloads (browsers, Discord, etc.).



If you want it to run automatically at startup, that’s a scheduled task. I can give you the installer block for that too, but this already does the core job.



Now go run your PC inventory script, and when it’s done we can use that report to tell whether D/G/H are SSD/HDD and adjust weights so it stops making dumb choices.

<#

PC_DeepInventory.ps1

Deep inventory of this PC (hardware, OS, drivers, apps, services, tasks, network, storage, security).

Outputs: JSON/CSV/TXT + a readable HTML report.

ALSO prints a console summary report automatically.



USAGE:

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\PC_DeepInventory.ps1

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\PC_DeepInventory.ps1 -DeepFileIndex



  # Print more to the console:

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\PC_DeepInventory.ps1 -PrintMsinfoHeadLines 200



NOTES:

- Best run as Administrator for the most complete output.

- Does NOT extract secrets or passwords.

function Test-Admin {

  $id = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()

  $p  = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($id)

  return $p.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)

}



function Ensure-Dir([string]$Path) {

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null

  }

function Write-Step([string]$Msg) {

  $ts = (Get-Date).ToString("HH:mm:ss")

  Write-Host "[$ts] $Msg"

}



function Save-Json($Obj, [string]$Path) {

  $Obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Encoding UTF8

}



function Save-Csv($Obj, [string]$Path) {

  $Obj | Export-Csv -LiteralPath $Path -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

}



function Save-Txt([string]$Text, [string]$Path) {

  $Text | Set-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Encoding UTF8

}



function Try-Capture([string]$Name, [scriptblock]$Block, [ref]$OutVar) {

  try {

    Write-Step "Collecting: $Name"

    $result = & $Block

    $OutVar.Value = $result

    return $null

  } catch {

    $err = $_ | Out-String

    Write-Warning "Failed: $Name"

    $OutVar.Value = $null

    return [pscustomobject]@{

      Name  = $Name

      Error = $err.Trim()

    }

  }

}



function Run-External([string]$Name, [string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args, [string]$OutFile) {

  Write-Step "Running: $Name"

  try {

    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $Exe -ArgumentList $Args -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru `

      -RedirectStandardOutput $OutFile -RedirectStandardError ($OutFile + ".err.txt")

    return [pscustomobject]@{ Name=$Name; ExitCode=$p.ExitCode; OutFile=$OutFile }

  } catch {

    return [pscustomobject]@{ Name=$Name; Error=($_ | Out-String).Trim(); OutFile=$OutFile }

  }

}

# -------------------- Software inventory --------------------

function Get-InstalledPrograms {

  $paths = @(

    "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

    "HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

    "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*"

  )

  $items = foreach ($p in $paths) {

    Get-ItemProperty -Path $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

      Where-Object { $_.DisplayName } |

      Select-Object DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher, InstallDate, InstallLocation, UninstallString, PSPath

  }

  $items | Sort-Object DisplayName -Unique

}

  $events = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

  foreach ($log in @("System","Application")) {

    $e = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName=$log; Level=2 } -MaxEvents 200 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

      Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, LevelDisplayName, ProviderName, Message

    foreach ($x in $e) {

      $events.Add([pscustomobject]@{

        Log=$log

        TimeCreated=$x.TimeCreated

        Id=$x.Id

        Provider=$x.ProviderName

        Message=$x.Message

      })

    }

  }

  $events

} ([ref]$tmpEvents))) | Out-Null

  Save-Json $tmpEvents (Join-Path $jsonDir "RecentErrors_System_Application.json")

# -------------------- Optional: file/folder index --------------------

function Get-FolderSizeBytes([string]$Path) {

  try {

    $sum = (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Path -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum

    if ($null -eq $sum) { return 0 }

    return [int64]$sum

  } catch {

    return -1

  }

}



if ($IncludeFileIndex -or $DeepFileIndex) {

  $tmpIndex = $null

  $errors.Add((Try-Capture "File index (WARNING: can be slow)" {

    $drives = Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Where-Object { Test-Path $_.Root }

    $index = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]



    foreach ($d in $drives) {

      $root = $d.Root

      Write-Step "Indexing drive root: $root"

      $top = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue



      foreach ($item in $top) {

        if ($item.PSIsContainer) {

          $bytes = Get-FolderSizeBytes $item.FullName

          $index.Add([pscustomobject]@{

            Drive = $root

            Type  = "Directory"

            Path  = $item.FullName

            SizeBytes = $bytes

          })

        } else {

          $index.Add([pscustomobject]@{

            Drive = $root

            Type  = "File"

            Path  = $item.FullName

            SizeBytes = $item.Length

          })

        }

      }



      if ($DeepFileIndex) {

        $deepPath = Join-Path $csvDir ("DeepFileIndex_" + ($root.TrimEnd("\").Replace(":","")) + ".csv")

        Write-Step "Deep indexing ALL paths under: $root (this can take ages and create huge files)"

        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

          Select-Object FullName, Length, LastWriteTime, Attributes |

          Export-Csv -LiteralPath $deepPath -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

      }

    }



    $index

  } ([ref]$tmpIndex))) | Out-Null



  if ($tmpIndex) {

    Save-Csv $tmpIndex (Join-Path $csvDir "DriveRootIndex.csv")

    Save-Json $tmpIndex (Join-Path $jsonDir "DriveRootIndex.json")

  }

}

if ($PrintConsoleReport) {

  Write-Section "CONSOLE REPORT (what you asked for)"



  # OS summary

  if ($os) {

    $osSummary = [pscustomobject]@{

      ComputerName = $env:COMPUTERNAME

      OS          = $os.Caption

      Version     = $os.Version

      Build       = $os.BuildNumber

      InstallDate = $os.InstallDate

      BootTime    = $os.LastBootUpTime

    }

    Write-Host "`n--- OS ---"

    $osSummary | Format-List | Out-String | Write-Host

  }



  # CPU/RAM/GPU summary

  if ($cpu) {

    Write-Host "--- CPU ---"

    $cpu | Select-Object Name, Manufacturer, NumberOfCores, NumberOfLogicalProcessors, MaxClockSpeed |

      Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  }



  if ($ram) {

    $totalGB = [math]::Round((($ram | Measure-Object -Property Capacity -Sum).Sum / 1GB), 2)

    Write-Host "--- RAM ---"

    Write-Host ("Total Installed RAM (GB): {0}" -f $totalGB)

    $ram | Select-Object Manufacturer, PartNumber, Speed, Capacity |

      ForEach-Object {

        $_.Capacity = [math]::Round(($_.Capacity / 1GB), 2)

        $_

      } | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  }



  if ($gpu) {

    Write-Host "--- GPU ---"

    $gpu | Select-Object Name, DriverVersion, VideoProcessor, AdapterRAM |

      ForEach-Object {

        $_.AdapterRAM = if ($_.AdapterRAM) { [math]::Round(($_.AdapterRAM / 1GB), 2) } else { $null }

        $_

      } | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  }



  # BIOS / board

  if ($bios) {

    Write-Host "--- BIOS ---"

    $bios | Select-Object Manufacturer, SMBIOSBIOSVersion, SerialNumber, ReleaseDate |

      Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  }

  if ($baseboard) {

    Write-Host "--- Motherboard ---"

    $baseboard | Select-Object Manufacturer, Product, SerialNumber, Version |

      Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  }



  # Storage

  if ($disks) {

    Write-Host "--- Disks ---"

    $disks | Select-Object Number, FriendlyName, BusType, MediaType, Size, PartitionStyle, HealthStatus |

      ForEach-Object {

        $_.Size = [math]::Round(($_.Size / 1GB), 2)

        $_

      } | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  }



  if ($vols) {

    Write-Host "--- Volumes ---"

    $vols | Select-Object DriveLetter, FileSystemLabel, FileSystem, Size, SizeRemaining, HealthStatus |

      ForEach-Object {

        $_.Size = [math]::Round(($_.Size / 1GB), 2)

        $_.SizeRemaining = [math]::Round(($_.SizeRemaining / 1GB), 2)

        $_

      } | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  }



  # Network quick view

  if ($netAdapters) {

    Write-Host "--- Network Adapters (Up) ---"

    $netAdapters | Where-Object Status -eq 'Up' |

      Select-Object Name, InterfaceDescription, LinkSpeed, MacAddress |

      Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  }



  if ($netIPs) {

    Write-Host "--- IP Addresses (IPv4) ---"

    $netIPs | Where-Object { $_.AddressFamily -eq 'IPv4' -and $_.IPAddress } |

      Select-Object InterfaceAlias, IPAddress, PrefixLength |

      Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  }



  # Counts

  Write-Host "--- Counts ---"

  $counts = [pscustomobject]@{

    InstalledPrograms = if ($installedPrograms) { $installedPrograms.Count } else { "n/a" }

    StoreApps         = if ($appxPackages) { $appxPackages.Count } else { "n/a" }

    Processes         = if ($processes) { $processes.Count } else { "n/a" }

    Services          = if ($services) { $services.Count } else { "n/a" }

    ScheduledTasks    = if ($tasks) { $tasks.Count } else { "n/a" }

    ErrorsCaptured    = $errorsClean.Count

  }

  $counts | Format-List | Out-String | Write-Host



  # Errors table

  if ($errorsClean.Count -gt 0) {

    Write-Host "--- Collection Errors ---"

    $errorsClean | Select-Object Name, Error |

      Format-Table -Wrap -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

  } else {

    Write-Host "--- Collection Errors ---"

    Write-Host "None."

  }



  # Optional msinfo32 head

  if ($PrintMsinfoHeadLines -gt 0 -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $msinfoPath)) {

    Write-Host "--- msinfo32 report (head) ---"

    Get-Content -LiteralPath $msinfoPath -TotalCount $PrintMsinfoHeadLines |

      ForEach-Object { $_ } | Out-String | Write-Host

    Write-Host ("(Printed first {0} lines. Full file: {1})" -f $PrintMsinfoHeadLines, $msinfoPath)

  }

}

PC_FullConsoleInventory.ps1

[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [string]$LogRoot = "D:\PC_Audit",

  [int]$MsinfoLines = 400,

  [switch]$PrintInstalledPrograms,

  [switch]$PrintAppxAllUsers

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"



function Write-Section([string]$Title) {

  Write-Host ""

  Write-Host ("=" * 90)

  Write-Host $Title

  Write-Host ("=" * 90)

}



function Test-Admin {

  try {

    $id = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()

    $p  = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($id)

    return $p.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)

  } catch { return $false }

}



function Safe-Run([string]$Name, [scriptblock]$Block) {

  Write-Host ""

  Write-Host ("--- {0} ---" -f $Name)

  try {

    & $Block

  } catch {

    Write-Warning ("FAILED: {0}`n{1}" -f $Name, ($_.Exception.Message))

  }

}



function Ensure-Dir([string]$Path) {

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null

  }

}



function Run-External([string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args) {

  $psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo

  $psi.FileName = $Exe

  $psi.Arguments = ($Args -join " ")

  $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true

  $psi.RedirectStandardError  = $true

  $psi.UseShellExecute = $false

  $psi.CreateNoWindow  = $true

  $p = New-Object System.Diagnostics.Process

  $p.StartInfo = $psi

  [void]$p.Start()

  $stdout = $p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()

  $stderr = $p.StandardError.ReadToEnd()

  $p.WaitForExit()

  return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode=$p.ExitCode; StdOut=$stdout; StdErr=$stderr }

}



function Get-InstalledPrograms {

  $paths = @(

    "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

    "HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

    "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*"

  )

  $items = foreach ($p in $paths) {

    Get-ItemProperty -Path $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

      Where-Object { $_.DisplayName } |

      Select-Object DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher, InstallDate, InstallLocation, UninstallString, PSPath

  }

  $items | Sort-Object DisplayName -Unique

}

  $r = Run-External -Exe "msinfo32.exe" -Args @("/report","`"$msinfoPath`"")

  if ($r.StdErr) { Write-Warning $r.StdErr.Trim() }

  Write-Host ("msinfo32 report created: {0}" -f $msinfoPath)



  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $msinfoPath) {

    Write-Host ""

    Write-Host ("--- Printing first {0} lines of msinfo32 report ---" -f $MsinfoLines)

    Get-Content -LiteralPath $msinfoPath -TotalCount $MsinfoLines

    Write-Host ""

    Write-Host ("(Full file is saved at: {0})" -f $msinfoPath)

  }

}

Safe-Run "RAM (Win32_PhysicalMemory + total)" {

  $ram = Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory

  $totalGB = [math]::Round((($ram | Measure-Object Capacity -Sum).Sum / 1GB), 2)

  Write-Host ("Total Installed RAM (GB): {0}" -f $totalGB)

  $ram | Select-Object Manufacturer, PartNumber, Speed, Capacity, SerialNumber, SMBIOSMemoryType |

    ForEach-Object { $_.Capacity = [math]::Round(($_.Capacity/1GB), 2); $_ } |

    Format-Table -AutoSize

Safe-Run "Monitors (WmiMonitorID)" {

  Get-CimInstance -Namespace root\wmi -ClassName WmiMonitorID -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

    ForEach-Object {

      $name = ($_.UserFriendlyName | Where-Object { $_ -ne 0 } | ForEach-Object {[char]$_}) -join ''

      [pscustomobject]@{

        InstanceName = $_.InstanceName

        Manufacturer = ($_.ManufacturerName | Where-Object {$_ -ne 0} | ForEach-Object {[char]$_}) -join ''

        Model        = $name

        Serial       = ($_.SerialNumberID | Where-Object {$_ -ne 0} | ForEach-Object {[char]$_}) -join ''

        Year         = $_.YearOfManufacture

      }

    } | Format-Table -AutoSize

}

Safe-Run "Startup (Run keys + Startup folders)" {

  $startup = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]



  $runKeys = @(

    "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",

    "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce",

    "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",

    "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce"

  )

  foreach ($rk in $runKeys) {

    $vals = Get-ItemProperty -Path $rk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    if ($vals) {

      $vals.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch "^PS" } | ForEach-Object {

        $startup.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source=$rk; Name=$_.Name; Command=$_.Value })

      }

    }

  }



  $startupFolders = @(

    "$env:ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup",

    "$env:AppData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup"

  )

  foreach ($sf in $startupFolders) {

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sf) {

      Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $sf -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {

        $startup.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Source=$sf; Name=$_.Name; Command=$_.FullName })

      }

    }

  }



  $startup | Format-Table -Wrap -AutoSize

}

<#

PC_FullConsoleInventory.ps1

EXTREMELY detailed PC inventory printed directly in the PowerShell window.



- Prints EVERYTHING to console in organized sections

- Also creates a transcript log automatically (same output, saved to disk)

- Does NOT dump passwords/Wi-Fi keys/etc.



Run:

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\PC_FullConsoleInventory.ps1



Optional:

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\PC_FullConsoleInventory.ps1 -MsinfoLines 800

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\PC_FullConsoleInventory.ps1 -PrintInstalledPrograms

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\PC_FullConsoleInventory.ps1 -PrintAppxAllUsers

#>



[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [string]$LogRoot = "D:\PC_Audit",

  [int]$MsinfoLines = 400,

  [switch]$PrintInstalledPrograms,

  [switch]$PrintAppxAllUsers

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"



function Write-Section([string]$Title) {

  Write-Host ""

  Write-Host ("=" * 90)

  Write-Host $Title

  Write-Host ("=" * 90)

}



function Test-Admin {

  try {

    $id = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()

    $p  = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($id)

    return $p.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)

  } catch { return $false }

}



function Safe-Run([string]$Name, [scriptblock]$Block) {

  Write-Host ""

  Write-Host ("--- {0} ---" -f $Name)

  try { & $Block }

  catch { Write-Warning ("FAILED: {0}`n{1}" -f $Name, ($_.Exception.Message)) }

}



function Ensure-Dir([string]$Path) {

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null

  }

}



function Run-External([string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args) {

  $psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo

  $psi.FileName = $Exe

  $psi.Arguments = ($Args -join " ")

  $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true

  $psi.RedirectStandardError  = $true

  $psi.UseShellExecute = $false

  $psi.CreateNoWindow  = $true

  $p = New-Object System.Diagnostics.Process

  $p.StartInfo = $psi

  [void]$p.Start()

  $stdout = $p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()

  $stderr = $p.StandardError.ReadToEnd()

  $p.WaitForExit()

  return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode=$p.ExitCode; StdOut=$stdout; StdErr=$stderr }

}



function Get-InstalledPrograms {

  $paths = @(

    "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

    "HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

    "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*"

  )

  $items = foreach ($p in $paths) {

    Get-ItemProperty -Path $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

      Where-Object { $_.DisplayName } |

      Select-Object DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher, InstallDate, InstallLocation, UninstallString, PSPath

  }

  $items | Sort-Object DisplayName -Unique

}

Safe-Run "Generate msinfo32 report file + print chunk" {

  $msinfoPath = Join-Path $runDir "msinfo32_report.txt"

  $r = Run-External -Exe "msinfo32.exe" -Args @("/report","`"$msinfoPath`"")

  if ($r.StdErr) { Write-Warning $r.StdErr.Trim() }



  Write-Host ("msinfo32 report created: {0}" -f $msinfoPath)



  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $msinfoPath) {

    Write-Host ""

    Write-Host ("--- Printing first {0} lines of msinfo32 report ---" -f $MsinfoLines)

    Get-Content -LiteralPath $msinfoPath -TotalCount $MsinfoLines

    Write-Host ""

    Write-Host ("(Full msinfo32 report saved at: {0})" -f $msinfoPath)

  }

}

  Write-Host ("Total Installed RAM (GB): {0}" -f $totalGB)



  $ram | Select-Object Manufacturer, PartNumber, Speed, Capacity, SerialNumber, SMBIOSMemoryType |

    ForEach-Object { $_.Capacity = [math]::Round(($_.Capacity/1GB), 2); $_ } |

    Format-Table -AutoSize

Safe-Run "Monitors (WmiMonitorID)" {

  Get-CimInstance -Namespace root\wmi -ClassName WmiMonitorID -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

    ForEach-Object {

      $name = ($_.UserFriendlyName | Where-Object { $_ -ne 0 } | ForEach-Object {[char]$_}) -join ''

      [pscustomobject]@{

        InstanceName = $_.InstanceName

        Manufacturer = ($_.ManufacturerName | Where-Object {$_ -ne 0} | ForEach-Object {[char]$_}) -join ''

        Model        = $name

        Serial       = ($_.SerialNumberID | Where-Object {$_ -ne 0} | ForEach-Object {[char]$_}) -join ''

        Year         = $_.YearOfManufacture

      }

    } | Format-Table -AutoSize

}

<#

Pick-BestDrive-DGH.ps1

Chooses best drive among D/G/H using:

- Free space (GB + %)

- Actual disk mapping (disk model, bus type, media type)

- Speed test (write+read temporary file)

Prints full report in the PowerShell console.



Run:

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Pick-BestDrive-DGH.ps1

Optional:

  pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Pick-BestDrive-DGH.ps1 -Candidates D,G,H -MinFreeGB 50 -TestMB 512

#>



[CmdletBinding()]

param(

  [string[]]$Candidates = @("D","G","H"),

  [int]$MinFreeGB = 20,

  [int]$TestMB = 256,

  [double]$WeightSpeed = 0.70,

  [double]$WeightFreePct = 0.30

)



Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"



function Write-Section([string]$Title) {

  Write-Host ""

  Write-Host ("=" * 90)

  Write-Host $Title

  Write-Host ("=" * 90)

}



function Get-VolInfo([string]$Letter) {

  $Letter = $Letter.Trim().TrimEnd(":","\")



  $root = "$Letter`:\"

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $root)) { return $null }



  $v = Get-Volume -DriveLetter $Letter -ErrorAction Stop

  if ($v.DriveType -ne 'Fixed') { return $null }



  $sizeGB = [math]::Round($v.Size / 1GB, 2)

  $freeGB = [math]::Round($v.SizeRemaining / 1GB, 2)

  $freePct = if ($v.Size -gt 0) { [math]::Round(($v.SizeRemaining / $v.Size) * 100, 2) } else { 0 }



  [pscustomobject]@{

    Drive     = $Letter

    Root      = $root

    Label     = $v.FileSystemLabel

    FS        = $v.FileSystemType

    SizeGB    = $sizeGB

    FreeGB    = $freeGB

    FreePct   = $freePct

  }

}



function Map-DriveToDisk([string]$Letter) {

  # Map drive letter -> partition -> disk number -> disk

  try {

    $p = Get-Partition -DriveLetter $Letter -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1

    $d = Get-Disk -Number $p.DiskNumber -ErrorAction Stop

    return [pscustomobject]@{

      DiskNumber   = $d.Number

      DiskName     = $d.FriendlyName

      BusType      = $d.BusType

      MediaType    = $d.MediaType

      Health       = $d.HealthStatus

      Operational  = ($d.OperationalStatus -join ",")

      DiskSizeGB   = [math]::Round($d.Size/1GB, 2)

    }

  } catch {

    return [pscustomobject]@{

      DiskNumber   = $null

      DiskName     = $null

      BusType      = $null

      MediaType    = $null

      Health       = $null

      Operational  = $null

      DiskSizeGB   = $null

    }

  }

}



function Measure-SpeedMBps([string]$Root, [int]$MB) {

  $testDir = Join-Path $Root ".drive_speedtest_temp"

  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $testDir -Force | Out-Null



  $file = Join-Path $testDir ("test_{0}.bin" -f ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N")))

  $bytesToWrite = $MB * 1MB



  $buffer = New-Object byte[](4MB)

  [System.Random]::new().NextBytes($buffer)



  # WRITE

  $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()

  $written = 0L

  $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($file, [System.IO.FileMode]::CreateNew, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Write, [System.IO.FileShare]::None)

  try {

    while ($written -lt $bytesToWrite) {

      $toWrite = [math]::Min($buffer.Length, $bytesToWrite - $written)

      $fs.Write($buffer, 0, $toWrite)

      $written += $toWrite

    }

    $fs.Flush($true)

  } finally {

    $fs.Dispose()

  }

  $sw.Stop()

  $writeSec = [math]::Max($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 0.001)

  $writeMBps = [math]::Round($MB / $writeSec, 2)



  # READ

  $sw.Restart()

  $read = 0L

  $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($file, [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read, [System.IO.FileShare]::Read)

  try {

    while ($true) {

      $n = $fs.Read($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)

      if ($n -le 0) { break }

      $read += $n

    }

  } finally {

    $fs.Dispose()

  }

  $sw.Stop()

  $readSec = [math]::Max($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 0.001)

  $readMBps = [math]::Round((($read/1MB) / $readSec), 2)



  # cleanup

  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $file -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

  try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $testDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}



  [pscustomobject]@{

    WriteMBps = $writeMBps

    ReadMBps  = $readMBps

    AvgMBps   = [math]::Round((($writeMBps + $readMBps)/2), 2)

  }

}



Write-Section "Drive Selection Report (D/G/H): speed + free space"

Write-Host ("Test size: {0} MB | MinFreeGB: {1} | Weights: Speed={2} FreePct={3}" -f $TestMB, $MinFreeGB, $WeightSpeed, $WeightFreePct)



$rows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]



foreach ($c in $Candidates) {

  $vol = Get-VolInfo $c

  if (-not $vol) {

    $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Drive=$c; Status="Not available / not fixed"; Score=$null }) | Out-Null

    continue

  }



  if ($vol.FreeGB -lt $MinFreeGB) {

    $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{

      Drive=$vol.Drive; Status="Too full (below MinFreeGB)"; FreeGB=$vol.FreeGB; FreePct=$vol.FreePct; Score=$null

    }) | Out-Null

    continue

  }



  $map = Map-DriveToDisk $vol.Drive



  Write-Host ""

  Write-Host ("Testing {0}: Free {1} GB ({2}%) | Disk: {3} | Bus: {4} | Media: {5}" -f `

    $vol.Drive, $vol.FreeGB, $vol.FreePct, $map.DiskName, $map.BusType, $map.MediaType)



  $spd = Measure-SpeedMBps -Root $vol.Root -MB $TestMB



  $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{

    Drive     = $vol.Drive

    Label     = $vol.Label

    FS        = $vol.FS

    SizeGB    = $vol.SizeGB

    FreeGB    = $vol.FreeGB

    FreePct   = $vol.FreePct

    DiskName  = $map.DiskName

    BusType   = $map.BusType

    MediaType = $map.MediaType

    WriteMBps = $spd.WriteMBps

    ReadMBps  = $spd.ReadMBps

    AvgMBps   = $spd.AvgMBps

    Status    = "OK"

    Score     = 0.0

  }) | Out-Null

}



$eligible = $rows | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq "OK" }

if (-not $eligible) { throw "No eligible drives found." }



$maxSpeed = ($eligible | Measure-Object AvgMBps -Maximum).Maximum

if ($maxSpeed -le 0) { $maxSpeed = 1 }



foreach ($r in $eligible) {

  $speedNorm = $r.AvgMBps / $maxSpeed

  $freeNorm  = $r.FreePct / 100.0

  $r.Score   = [math]::Round(($speedNorm * $WeightSpeed) + ($freeNorm * $WeightFreePct), 4)

}



Write-Section "Results"

($rows | Sort-Object Score -Descending) | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host



$best = $eligible | Sort-Object Score -Descending | Select-Object -First 1



Write-Section "Chosen Drive"

Write-Host ("BEST DRIVE: {0}:  {1}  | AvgMBps={2} | Free={3}GB ({4}%)" -f `

  $best.Drive, $best.DiskName, $best.AvgMBps, $best.FreeGB, $best.FreePct)



# Emit just the letter as final output too (useful for piping into other scripts)

$best.Drive

PS C:\Users\FRANK> function Run-External([string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args) {

>>   $psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo

>>   $psi.FileName = $Exe

>>   $psi.Arguments = ($Args -join " ")

>>   $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true

>>   $psi.RedirectStandardError  = $true

>>   $psi.UseShellExecute = $false

>>   $psi.CreateNoWindow  = $true

>>   $p = New-Object System.Diagnostics.Process

>>   $p.StartInfo = $psi

>>   [void]$p.Start()

>>   $stdout = $p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()

>>   $stderr = $p.StandardError.ReadToEnd()

>>   $p.WaitForExit()

>>   return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode=$p.ExitCode; StdOut=$stdout; StdErr=$stderr }

>> }

PS C:\Users\FRANK> function Get-InstalledPrograms {

>>   $paths = @(

>>     "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

>>     "HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*",

>>     "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*"

>>   )

>>   $items = foreach ($p in $paths) {

>>     Get-ItemProperty -Path $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

>>       Where-Object { $_.DisplayName } |

>>       Select-Object DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher, InstallDate, InstallLocation, UninstallString, PSPath

>>   }

>>   $items | Sort-Object DisplayName -Unique

>> }
